items.title: Lifting a factorisation of a monic polynomial after an etale base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma lifts a factorisation of the reduction of a monic polynomial, whose first factor has invertible leading coefficient and such that the two factors generate the unit ideal, after an etale ring map inducing an isomorphism on the quotient. The proof first makes the leading coefficient of the first factor the reduction of a unit, which is legitimate after the etale base change supplied by the lifting result for invertible elements, then rescales the two factors so that the first one becomes monic, which forces the second to be monic as well because the polynomial itself is monic, and finally applies the lifting statement for factorisations into monic polynomials.
